conflicts.description: Legacy sources disagree on label: 'Ball Roll Tilt' versus 'Drop Target 2 (Left Bank)'. Resolution path: this machine's own printed Bally switch table, no copy of which is currently retained, or a LibPinMAME gameplay-harness trace against a legal beatclck ROM holding public switch 2 to see whether the ROM registers a tilt, and pulsing the drop-target bank reset coil at public solenoid 11 to see whether 2 clears with the rest of its bank -- pinned BY35_COMPORTS writes no cabinet input into public 2, so unlike public 7 and 16 that address can be held. Unresolved.

Legacy sources disagree on label: 'Tilt' versus 'Drop Target 6 (Left Bank)'. Resolution path: this machine's own printed Bally switch table, no copy of which is currently retained, or a continuity check on the switch harness at that matrix position; a harness hold cannot settle it, because pinned BY35_COMPORTS puts Ball Tilt on switch column 1 bit 6 and SWITCH_UPDATE(by35) rewrites public 7 from the cabinet input port every frame on every BY35 game. Unresolved.

Legacy sources disagree on label: 'Slam Tilt' versus 'Wire Trigger'. Resolution path: this machine's own printed Bally switch table, no copy of which is currently retained, or a continuity check on the switch harness at that matrix position; a harness hold cannot settle it, because pinned BY35_COMPORTS puts Slam Tilt on switch column 2 bit 7 and SWITCH_UPDATE(by35) rewrites public 16 from the cabinet input port every frame on every BY35 game. Unresolved.
